comparison.objective: Fit a spring tension rod between walls at a marked height; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Compress, align and release a long spring-loaded rod level between surfaces versus bend wire and insert a fine blade beneath a recessed latch.
comparison.success_condition: Rod self-supporting, level and at the band versus selected terminal removed with housing and neighbors intact. Candidate numeric thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded placement and frictional retention are unrelated to connector depinning.
